verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs name audit logging as a security feature, and the about page lists 'Audit Logs' as an offering, so the capability is first-party. The evidence is only bare mentions, with nothing on what it records or how a devops lead reviews it. Missing for 10: documentation of which user and administrative actions are logged, a described review interface (UI, filtering, search or export), clarity on which edition or tier includes Audit Logs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review an audit log of user and administrative actions

citations.quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, audit logging, and more to ensure the security of code and data.
